issue: Zorn argument checks only a countable descending chain and uses compactness without stating the empty-intersection contradiction.
action: Use an arbitrary totally ordered family of nonempty closed sets; compactness gives its nonempty intersection, then apply Zorn.

issue: Filters on A and X are not distinguished in the formula for limits under an inclusion.
action: Specify the ambient sets and prove Lim_A(F)=A intersect Lim_X(i_*F) from the subspace topology.

issue: Continuity is claimed to imply equality of the pushed-forward neighborhood filter and the target neighborhood filter; (ii) to (iii) is unsupported.
action: Use N_{f(x)} subset f_*N_x; prove accumulation preservation directly by preimages of neighborhoods.

issue: Hausdorffness is said to give precisely one of two points as a limit, and the converse filter-base argument has its conditional reversed.
action: Replace precisely one by at most one; if no disjoint neighborhoods exist, intersections form a proper filter base.

issue: Compactness is misused to say an arbitrary intersection of closures is a finite intersection.
action: Show the closed family {closure(M):M in F} has the finite-intersection property, and apply quasi-compactness.

issue: The restriction of an ultrafilter to the quasi-compact open intersection is not justified.
action: Use the inclusion-ultrafilter bijection since the intersection lies in the ultrafilter.

issue: The T0/unique-generic-limit proposition assumes what it claims to characterize; its proof mistakenly derives Hausdorffness from T0.
action: State existence of generic limits, then T0 iff their representing generic points are unique; remove the Hausdorff inference.

issue: The proof about irreducible closed sets asserts Z=Lim U without establishing the equality.
action: Prove that the selected ultrafilter has Lim U=Z, or provide a correct irreducibility/ultrafilter argument.

issue: The closure-under-generic-limits proof uses M in U instead of the intersection and applies glim to an ultrafilter on V without justification.
action: Use M_I in U and the generic limit of the pushed-forward ultrafilter on X.

issue: Topological distinguishability in the target of f is attributed to X being T0.
action: Use the T0 property of Y.

issue: The prime-ideal argument treats V(a_2), a set, as an element of the ideal g_U and omits some ideal axioms.
action: Replace V(a_2) notin g_U by V(a_2) notin U; check 0, properness, and absorption explicitly.

issue: The constructible-topology proof claims an ultrafilter on X_2 has a limit because its direct image has a limit in coarser X.
action: Prove that the generic limit in X is a limit for the topology defined by glim-closed sets; do not infer lifting of limits under a continuous map.

issue: K_x is substituted for K_1 in a comparison of Boolean algebras.
action: Replace K_x by K_1.

issue: A spectral space is described as a spectral and a specialization relation is introduced without clearly identifying the topology.
action: Rewrite the definition with x,y in a spectral space X and closure in X.

issue: Rational intersection formula gives 0<=i<=n, although the first tuple ends at m.
action: Use 0<=i<=m and 0<=j<=n, including both zero-index factors as needed.

issue: Ultraproduct formula mixes representative valuations, quotient notation, and values f_i(x), which are not elements of the ring.
action: Choose valuations consistently and use |f_i|_x throughout; define the target ultraproduct precisely.

issue: The support-map preimage formula is written as supp(D(f))=R(f|), with incompatible spaces.
action: Use supp^{-1}(D(f))=R(f|).

issue: For I finitely generated, Spv(R/I) is incorrectly identified with a union of opens R(g_i|).
action: Use intersection_i V(g_i)=Spv(R) minus union_i R(g_i|).

issue: A multiplicative subset S is said to be a subset of S.
action: Specify S subset R.

issue: K_{x<=gamma} and K_{x<gamma} are written independently of the representative although gamma belongs to a chosen value group.
action: Choose a representative and transport gamma under equivalence; intrinsic comparisons with elements a of R remain valid.

issue: Integral-closedness proof omits the constant coefficient p_0 and has K_{r<=1} in place of K_{v<=1}.
action: Compare v(r^m) with all terms p_i r^i for 0<=i<m, assuming v(r)>1.

issue: Convex hull of the values is called merely a subgroup generated by values >1 without explaining the convexity issue.
action: Specify and justify the exact subgroup equality, or keep the safe convex-subgroup formulation.

issue: Horizontal-specialization proposition refers to Definition 1.2.10 rather than the definition of v|_H.
action: Reference label definition_7_10.

issue: The horizontal-specialization proof drops v(f_0) in H and concludes equivalence of rational membership for v and v|_H.
action: Retain w(f_0)!=0: w in R iff v in R and w(f_0)!=0.

issue: The multiplicativity proof of the truncated valuation begins by assuming phi(m_1m_2)=0.
action: Separate cases by m_1,m_2 in H and prove compatibility of products explicitly.

issue: Spv(R) is claimed linearly ordered under specialization for every valuation ring, false already for R=Q.
action: Replace with Spec(R) linearly ordered by inclusion; do not assert linearity of all valuations.

issue: DVR equivalence fails for a field if DVR means a nonfield local PID.
action: Specify whether fields are allowed as DVRs, or exclude the field case.

issue: The displayed maximal-ideal formula takes elements outside R instead of nonunits in R.
action: Use m_R={0} union {x in K^times: x^{-1} notin R}.

issue: Determinant trick uses repeated index i and invokes a characteristic polynomial without explaining its action on a nonfree module.
action: Write bm_i=sum_j a_ij m_j and use the adjugate/Cayley-Hamilton determinant trick on generators.

issue: Coefficient tuples indexed from 0 to d_+-1 are assigned to R[T]^(d_+-1), off by one.
action: Use d_+ and d_- entries.

issue: k^- is undefined and e=0 would make N generated by an empty range.
action: Use k^{-1}, and replace e by max(1, degrees) before defining 0<=j<2e.

issue: The finite-intersection proof contains the ill-typed equality nu^*S_2=T and is missing a clean pullback calculation.
action: Use nu^*(S_1 cap S_2)=nu^*S_1 cap nu^*S_2 and GT-Loc.

issue: Sieve definition for a basis category demands every open subset of V, including ones not in the basis.
action: When the category is a basis B, restrict W to objects of B; distinguish from O_X.

issue: The generated-sieve formula is said to follow from a covering-sieve proposition, an irrelevant dependency.
action: Prove its minimality directly from the sieve condition.

issue: The proof of the correspondence between topologies on B and O_X ends halfway through GT-Trans.
action: Prove GT-Triv, GT-Trans, GT-Loc for both constructions, and show the maps inverse.

issue: G+-base definition quantifies U in O_U, making U self-referential.
action: Use for all U in O_X.

issue: G+-quasi-compactness is defined for V while the quantification is over covering sieves of U.
action: Use V consistently: S in T_V and finite covering subsieve of V.

issue: The G+-cover proof of GT-Triv uses U instead of each basis element Omega and requires a finite-cover intersection argument.
action: For every Omega in B_U take Theta=Omega; for restriction use finite basis refinements.

issue: Ambient variable reads U in O_U and the correspondence reuses U ambiguously.
action: Use U in O_X and distinguish xi_U from xi.

issue: Complement of a maximal noncovering sieve is written O_U minus S though S is an X-sieve.
action: Use O_X minus S.

issue: The proof that maximal noncovering sieves have prime complements assumes U_1 cap U_2 in S without saying so and contains broken sentences.
action: Argue by contradiction: if U_1,U_2 notin S and intersection in S, GT-Loc makes S covering.

issue: The restriction to Omega is identified with an X-global covering lemma without stating the induced G+ structure.
action: Apply the lemma to the restricted space Omega and use pullback, not pushforward, of the sieve.

issue: The sobriety proof begins with an irreducible subset instead of an irreducible closed subset and does not justify closure equality.
action: Take Z irreducible closed; show the constructed xi has closure exactly Z.

issue: Ultrafilter notation switches between U and F without defining F.
action: Use a single ultrafilter symbol and quantify Omega appropriately.

issue: The stalk-equivalence relation writes g|_Xi=g|_Xi, making it tautological, and swaps pair order.
action: Require Xi in xi and g|_Xi=r|_Xi for (Omega,g) and (Theta,r).

issue: Skyscraper formula omits the case condition on its second branch and restrictions.
action: Complete cases U in xi / U notin xi, with the correct group-valued restriction maps.

issue: Exactness of stalks is asserted for arbitrary presheaf targets, while exactness requires an abelian context; the sheafification symbol is inconsistent.
action: State the category of abelian-group presheaves and define the sheafification functor used.

issue: Phrase x in in X and the index changes xi to x.
action: Use xi in X*.

issue: Inverse sheaf-equivalence construction is written as a morphism G(U)->H(U*) instead of a definition of G(U).
action: Define G(U)=H(U*) and explain natural restrictions.

issue: The proof of the extensive sheafification and stalk proposition consists only of a general reference phrase.
action: Supply proofs or explicitly declare the proposition quoted and cite the corresponding source.

issue: Proof T0 implies {1} closed starts with x in {1} rather than x in its closure and incorrectly applies inversion.
action: Start x in closure({1}), then show x and 1 indistinguishable using translation/inversion.

issue: Cosets in nonnormal subgroup G/H are indexed by G/H minus {0}.
action: Use union over left cosets gH distinct from H, avoiding additive zero notation.

issue: Boundedness example uses the test ball inside X, not the ambient module M, and sets B=|x|^{-1} without fixing x.
action: Choose U={m in M: ||m||<=epsilon} and an appropriate scalar ball.

issue: Q_p to Q_q is offered as a morphism counterexample without a continuous unital homomorphism.
action: Remove the example or supply an actual continuous ring morphism with unbounded image.

issue: Chosen unit rho need not belong to V' to yield rho X subset U'; final product estimate is malformed.
action: Take rho in V' intersect R^times and pick a sufficiently small target neighborhood to show boundedness.

issue: The tail union is union_{k>=m} X^m rather than X^k.
action: Correct exponent and the range notation on the finite union.

issue: Proof of finite unions of bounded topologically nilpotent sets contains dangling uncompleted displayed formulas.
action: Delete fragments and replace by the completed induction proof.

issue: The union for XY's powers has reversed index inequality.
action: Use union_{k>=m}(XY)^k subset (union_{l>=0}X^l)(union_{k>=m}Y^k).

issue: An unusually strong topological-vector-space quotient theorem is stated without hypotheses or reference.
action: Supply a precise theorem with hypotheses and citation, or remove.

issue: The claim K_{v<a}=empty when a in supp(v) is true, but those sets are then called additive subgroups.
action: Exclude the empty case from the subgroup assertion.

issue: Equality v^{-1}({v(a)})=a+K_{r<a} is false in general; r is also undefined.
action: Use inclusion a+K_{v<a} subset v^{-1}({v(a)}), sufficient for continuity.

issue: Representation gamma=v(a)/v(b) is used correctly only for elements of the generated group but the proof for the convex hull needs detailed group-order reasoning.
action: Explain the reduction to a bounding delta and justify openness of a larger subgroup.

issue: A valuation is called open when the intended property is continuity.
action: Replace open with continuous.

issue: Cohen's theorem is conflated with Eakin-Nagata.
action: Attribute the prime-ideal characterization of Noetherian rings to Cohen's theorem.

issue: The continuity criterion asks v(ab)>=1, but this permits a noncontinuous trivial valuation.
action: Require v(ab)>1 and repair the preimage inclusion.

issue: The map to the quotient field notation uses alpha mod p and omits some qualifications about its image.
action: Use bars in k(p) consistently and state the integrality claim there.

issue: The ordered value-group argument is written as an ordinary real limit.
action: Conclude directly from continuity and nonconvergence of powers with value >=1.

issue: The set Spa(A) is used before defining a plus-subring, making the ambient set undefined.
action: Use Spv(A) for valuations that can be made continuous.

issue: The definition of sGamma_eta compares K_{eta<r} without quantifying or defining r.
action: Use K_{eta<gamma} and state the dependence on gamma in Gamma_eta.

issue: Argument for subgroup closure uses |a^{-1}| for arbitrary a in A, not necessarily a unit.
action: Rewrite in terms of value-group elements and prove inverse closure explicitly.

issue: A sentence in the continuation proof ends with 'Let a in A be such that
action: a|_eta.'|Specify a not in supp(s), then prove K_{s<a} is open.

issue: The continuation theorem proof does not explicitly establish inverse closure of sGamma_eta; several inequalities need justification.
action: Reconstruct proof of convex subgroup, continuity, universal specialization, and rational opens in logical order.

issue: The intersection formula mismatches n,m, and product ideal indices.
action: Use both index ranges 0<=i<=n and 0<=j<=m.

issue: The newly appended epsilon's run through n instead of l.
action: Change epsilon_1,...,epsilon_n to epsilon_1,...,epsilon_l.

issue: The set-builder condition has v bound but uses x within |a|_x.
action: Use a single variable v or x.

issue: Proof of spectrality/generic limits contains an unfinished sentence.
action: Complete the implication connecting c and d before the displayed formula.

issue: Spectrality is invoked before verifying that the proposed basis is closed under generic limits.
action: Establish generic limits and rational-basis closure, then apply the spectral criterion.

issue: Closed-point proof only shows horizontal specializations remain continuous; closedness is never used.
action: Apply closedness to rule out any proper horizontal specialization, forcing cGamma_x=Gamma_x.

issue: Continuity of intermediate specialization is claimed using K_{eta<a} subset K_{x<a}, although eta need not be continuous.
action: Use the continuous point s and the appropriate strict-ball inclusions along specializations.

issue: Spa(A,A+)_a is defined as all analytic points of Cont(A).
action: Restrict x to Spa(A,A+).

issue: The proof incorrectly states every open ideal contains A^{oo}, and duplicates ii in its implication chain.
action: For open J, show powers of topologically nilpotent elements lie in J; use radical/maximal ideals correctly.

issue: Proof of the finite-generation/open-ideal criterion changes x to s and has an underjustified continuity argument.
action: Use one topologically nilpotent element and rederive the value-group estimates and neighborhood inclusions.

issue: Proof invokes closure of topologically nilpotent elements under finite sums without the relevant boundedness hypotheses.
action: Regroup as 1=(x mod p) q with q powerbounded; use product nilpotence instead.

issue: Necessity proof for generating unit ideal implicitly needs a continuous trivial valuation at open maximal ideal.
action: State why an open maximal ideal yields a continuous trivial valuation that respects A+.

issue: Open-mapping lemma checks only neighborhoods of 1 and uses imprecise g(Ux^{-1}) notation.
action: First prove image of every neighborhood of identity is a neighborhood and use translates for openness.

issue: Proof of adic equivalent conditions covers a and b but not equivalence with c under (oifin).
action: Use an open finitely generated ideal and the change-of-generators lemma in both directions.

issue: Proof that analytic rings make every module adic incorrectly applies a result assuming open ideals form a neighborhood basis.
action: Use the finite family of topologically nilpotent generators to construct open row maps for arbitrary module neighborhoods.

issue: Proof of adicity transfer presumes an algebra's adicity rather than explicitly the adic A-module hypothesis.
action: Invoke the module's adicity for f^{-1}(I) and use continuity of the A action correctly.

issue: Restriction of open row maps to open submodule N is asserted without ensuring the image and preimage openness.
action: Prove the induced N^m to N map is open using the open submodule structure.

issue: The induction from XY' subset Y'' to (X')^m subset Y' lacks the necessary XY' subset Y' reasoning.
action: Expand products and show X'Y' subset Y' to justify induction; separate powerbounded and nilpotent claims.

issue: Integral-closedness proof assumes the whole A^circ is bounded and concludes integral x lies in A^{oo} instead of A^circ.
action: Use finite coefficient-generated bounded subring and prove boundedness of {x^n}, hence x in A^circ.

issue: Text describes A^{oo} as topologically nilpotent while its C_p example has (A^{oo})^2=A^{oo}.
action: State that A^{oo} need not be topologically nilpotent as a subset.

issue: Sequential compactness is used where sequential completeness and geometric-series convergence suffice; inversion continuity is not proved.
action: Replace with sufficient completeness hypothesis, use convergent geometric series, and prove inversion continuity locally.

issue: Adicity proof omits requiring coefficients omega_i to lie in the selected neighborhood Omega, and leaves 'write?' in the argument.
action: Choose omega_i in Omega and check finite sums in V act on f(X) as required.

issue: Monomial formula omits exponents, writing product_i a_i alpha_i.
action: Write product_i a_i^{alpha_i}.

issue: Proof infers I subset A^{oo} from I^n subset B; bounded containment does not imply nilpotence.
action: Use I^n->0 in the I-adic topology to show each x in I has x^n->0.

issue: Statement 'a neighborhood X of A is bounded' confuses a subset of A with a neighborhood of A.
action: State for a subset X of A, with the precise boundedness criterion.

issue: Generators of I numbered m but completion generator list ends at n.
action: Use matching generator count.

issue: Proof uses undefined B and claims all roots of T^n-x^n lie in A+.
action: Use x^n in A+ and conclude only that x is integral over A+.

issue: Proof of the main Spa theorem invokes itself when identifying the topology, creating a circular citation.
action: Apply the independently proved strong/weak-topology criterion and Huber conditions.

issue: Perturbation proof stops at 'Hence M' and neither proves the rational domains equal nor handles new generators i>m.
action: Finish the maximum-value inequalities for all i, including the newly added zero coordinates.

issue: The error matrix omits index j=0 in g_i-f_i=sum n_ij f_j.
action: Index 0<=j<=m and 0<=i<=n appropriately.

issue: Power-series algebra is written A<X_1,...,X_0> instead of X_n.
action: Use X_1,...,X_n and state the intended universal property precisely.

issue: Lemma on quotient multiplication images assumes a subset containing a neighborhood is automatically open.
action: Choose additive open subgroups so the inverse image is a subgroup; an open subgroup inclusion then implies openness.

issue: A point of closure(I) is claimed killed by some power of f, which need not hold.
action: Show tau vanishes on I and then on closure(I) using continuity and closedness of ker(tau).

issue: Injectivity proof has inconsistent indexing d_0 and U_{-1} and an undefined a_j.
action: Start at n=1, use convergent correction series, and conclude a-j belongs to I or its closure.

issue: Localization universal-property proof stops before proving part c (Huber/completeness equivalence).
action: Use A open in A_f and the given Huber pair of definition; justify completeness of open subgroup and its union.

issue: f^{-m}A is called an open subgroup of A instead of A_f.
action: Change ambient additive group to A_f.

issue: Proof refers to (A,+) when establishing natness of polynomial ring.
Openness of quotient multiplication uses openness of a row map not justified for arbitrary nat A; coefficientwise argument is incomplete.
action: Supply the needed adicity assumption (or prove row openness) and show V[X] subset f_0 U[X]+I coefficientwise.

issue: Universal-property proof cites part d instead of the evaluation result f.
action: Refer to part f and the adic condition.

issue: Arbitrary closed ideal I is written equal to the whole A<X> while required to contain relations.
action: Use I subset A<X_1,...,X_n>, closed, containing all f_0X_i-f_i; include f_0 in the open coefficient ideal.

issue: Definition of powerbounded repeats the boundedness criterion; monomials are called powerbounded as a set without proof.
action: Use boundedness of all monomials to deduce each finite set of variables is powerbounded.

issue: F_Omega is declared contravariant on Huber pairs but sends C to morphisms A->C, a covariant construction.
action: Set F_Omega:P->Sets, with maps acting by postcomposition.

issue: Evaluation F(phi)(b) is said to lie in category Sets instead of the set F(C).
action: Replace codomain by F(C).

issue: Canonical localization target omits quotient by J and is falsely set equal to B.
action: Use (A<X>/J)_{f_0} as the target.

issue: b(X_i) is undefined because b has domain A; valuation product formula is circular/incorrect.
action: Let q_i be image of X_i in B and state |b(f_i)|_y=|q_i|_y |b(f_0)|_y<=|b(f_0)|_y.

issue: q_i is defined for i=1,...,m but used for i=0,...,m.
action: Use 1<=i<=m, or define q_0=1 explicitly.

issue: A^+[X_0,...,X_m] uses wrong variable list.
action: Use X_1,...,X_m.

issue: Corollary simplification requires f_0 invertible in the quotient but its displayed tuple lacks separators.
action: Write (f_0,f_0X_1,...,f_0X_m)= (f_0) and conclude the quotient is generated by f_0.

issue: Proof refers to items d and e though corollary has a-d only.
action: Correct enumeration and cross-references.

issue: Localization union uses undefined f instead of f_0, and X_0 appears unexpectedly.
action: Use f_0 and X_1,...,X_m.

issue: Extension of valuations uses undefined gamma=v(a), assumes valuation codomain Hausdorff at zero, and gives no proof independence of sequences.
action: Use gamma=v(alpha) when nonzero; show eventual value stabilization, independence, and continuity explicitly.

issue: Unknown valuation v_0 and K_{v<=gamma} preimage is claimed to lie in a strict interval.
action: Use v_{f_0} and K_{v<gamma}; align m and n indices.

issue: hat v_1, a valuation, is equated to a value v(f_0).
action: Write hat v_1(f_0)=v(f_0)!=0.

issue: Polynomial q is assigned the tuple (f_0,...,f_m) instead of evaluation Q(f_0,...,f_m).
action: Define q=Q(f_0,...,f_m) and prove f_0^dP-q lies in I.

issue: Openness of beta uses 'small enough' generators without supplying perturbation estimates.
action: Invoke a completed perturbation lemma to maintain equality of rational domains after adding small elements.

issue: Rational intersection product list is left as the words 'all other f_i phi_j'.
action: State the full indexed family f_i phi_j and unit-ideal requirement.

issue: Spa(A) is compared with Spa(hat A) without specifying plus-parts on both Huber pairs.
action: Use Spa(A^triangleleft,A+) and the completion with induced/integrally closed plus-part.

issue: Acyclicity lemma's hypothesis repeats X' in X rather than requiring the quotient X'' in X.
action: Replace duplicated condition by X'' in class X.

issue: An explanatory remark contains literal question marks and no completed claim.
action: Delete or replace with a fully stated boundedness proposition.

issue: Rational refinement proof applies closed-point rational-neighborhood lemma to every x in X.
action: Apply it only for x in X_cl, then use density of open sets containing all closed points in a spectral space.

issue: The multi-index construction switches i_j and f_{i,j}; product uses m instead of m_j.
action: Standardize f_{i,j} and 0<=j<=m_i throughout.

issue: Value |f_{j,0}| lacks the point subscript.
action: Write |f_{j,0}|_x.

issue: A sheaf acyclicity-class result is asserted without checking the acyclicity lemma hypotheses.
action: Show stability under direct summands, embedding into class, and the short-exact-sequence condition, or cite a proven theorem.

action: Call it a preorder, with an equivalence relation for tied values.

issue: Finite set G has n elements but proof uses m and undefined g_0.
action: Use g_1<=...<=g_n and Omega=R(g_n|g_1,...,g_{n-1}).

issue: Restriction label Theta2 is missing a subscript brace.

action: Use 0<=i<=m.

action: Require G to generate the unit ideal/rational covering and justify unit status and finite Laurent order on both pieces.

issue: Final acyclicity criterion is stated without proof of closure properties of its sheaf class.
